deadline.value: The deadline for admission and Oxford scholarship consideration is 2026-12-02.
deadline.quote: 12:00 midday UK time on Wednesday 2 December 2026

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to achieve either a first-class or strong upper second-class four-year undergraduate degree with honours, or a bachelor's and a master's degree with merit or distinction.
entry_route.quote: a first-class or a strong upper second-class four-year undergraduate degree with honours in a relevant subject, or a first-class or a strong upper second-class three-year undergraduate degree with honours and a master's degree with merit or distinction

supervisor.value: Applicants can contact potential supervisors directly before applying, but are not required to secure a supervisor in advance.
supervisor.quote: Academic staff profiles contain information on their research interests and will help you identify potential supervisors. You can contact potential supervisors directly

funding.value: All eligible applicants who apply by the deadline are automatically considered for Oxford scholarships.
funding.quote: Final application deadline to be considered for Oxford scholarships

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: DPhil in Computer Science at the University of Oxford.
